theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) 2) (z : Euclid P) (k : ℕ) (δ L : ℝ), IsMinimizingIn C univ → BoundaryVanishes C → IsConeCurrent C → z ∈ C.support → ‖z‖ = 1 → 1 ≤ k → 0 < δ → 0 < L → (∀ y ∈ C.support, y ∈ ball z δ → HasMassDensity C y k) → (∀ a ∈ C.support, ‖a‖ = 1 → a ∈ ball z L → HasMassDensity C a k → ∃ (δ' : ℝ) (k' : ℕ), 0 < δ' ∧ ∀ y ∈ C.support, y ∈ ball a δ' → HasMassDensity C y k') → ∃ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), Module.finrank ℝ Q = 2 ∧ z ∈ Q ∧ ∀ x ∈ (Q : Set (Euclid P)) ∩ ball z (min (1 / 2) (L / 4)), ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ C.support ∩ ball x ε = (Q : Set (Euclid P)) ∩ ball x ε ∧ (∀ y ∈ C.support, y ∈ ball x ε → HasMassDensity C y k) ∧ ∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → W ⊆ ball x ε → μHE[2] (W ∩ (Q : Set (Euclid P))) ≤ C.massOn W
